title: Closed direct image is fully faithful at every coefficient stage
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type
$k$-schemes and let $\Lambda$ be one of the coefficient stages
$A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb$, with the categories $D^b_c(-,\Lambda)$ of
[def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed],
[def-weil-rationalization-karoubi],
[def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and the direct image
$i_*=Ri_*=Ri_!$ of [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Then

$$
i_*:D^b_c(Z,\Lambda)\longrightarrow D^b_c(X,\Lambda)
$$

is fully faithful. Consequently, at every stage at which $i_*$ has a right
adjoint $Ri^!$ on these categories (the exceptional inverse image of
[def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]), the adjunction unit is an isomorphism

$$
Q\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Ri^!i_*Q\qquad(Q\in D^b_c(Z,\Lambda)).
$$

At $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$ the right adjoint exists on the ambient categories and
this is [prop-sf-closed-immersion-unit].

proof.text: A field has only two ideals and a one-point spectrum. Finite type over this Noetherian field makes $X,Z$ Noetherian; hence every affine intersection with $U=X\setminus Z$ is quasi-compact. A closed immersion is finite, separated and universally closed, hence proper. The identity compactification computes $Ri_!=Ri_*$; the same finite tower, its rationalization and its common-stage passage give this identification at every stage.

The recollement counit $i^*Ri_{*,n}\to\mathrm{id}$ is invertible, so the counit criterion makes $Ri_{*,n}$ fully faithful on the ambient category. The finite immersion lemma identifies it with termwise exact $i_*$ and preserves constructible partitions and cohomological intervals. Thus it restricts to $D^b_c$. The closed-support theorem supplies its ambient right adjoint.

source.place: Finite-stage paragraph and ambient existence; returned steps 2-3, 11

proof.text: Put $R=\mathcal O_E$, $A_n=R/t^n$, and let $F$ be ordinary completed-ring direct image. The DVR quotients are finite and perfect, via $[R\xrightarrow{t^n}R]$. Normalized completed pushforward gives $\psi:F\cong I$, where $I$ is the specified integral direct image; integral constructibility supplies its actual invertible reduction maps. The identity scalar-completion comparison and direct-image/limit comparison identify the image of the strict reduction Roos triangle, including its connecting arrow, with the image-tower triangle.

The reduction Hom-square lemma identifies $F$ on $\operatorname{Hom}(P[m],\operatorname{Res}_nQ_n)$ with the finite direct-image Hom map, compatibly with transitions. Step 2 makes these bijections. The Roos lifting lemma, applied using step 3's product and triangle comparisons, makes $F$ bijective on $\operatorname{Hom}(P,Q)$. Naturality gives $I(u)=\psi_QF(u)\psi_P^{-1}$, hence integral full faithfulness.

The strict scalar-comparison lemma makes $I$ linear. Its Hom bijection tensored with $E$ has inverse the integral inverse tensored with $E$, proving rational full faithfulness in the raw localization. That lemma also supplies the coherent scalar comparisons; the common-stage lemma now proves full faithfulness over $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$.

source.place: Rational and algebraically closed stages; returned steps 8-9

proof.text: For any right adjoint $G$, adjunction identifies $F(g)$ with $\eta_Qg$. Thus $\eta_Q\circ-$ is bijective. Taking $P=GFQ$ gives $r$ with $\eta_Qr=1$; injectivity at $P=Q$ gives $r\eta_Q=1$. Hence the specified unit is invertible. Step 2 gives the finite ambient adjunction, so this also holds for every ambient finite-coefficient $Q$, as in the finite closed-unit proposition.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type
$k$-schemes and let $\Lambda$ be one of the coefficient rings
$A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb$, regarded as condensed rings, with the
categories $D^b_c(-,\Lambda)\subseteq D(-_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$ of
[def-sf-setting] and the direct image $i_*=Ri_*=Ri_!$ of
[def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Then

$$
i_*:D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)\longrightarrow D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)
$$

is fully faithful, and so is its restriction
$i_*:D^b_c(Z,\Lambda)\to D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$. Consequently, the right adjoint
$Ri^!$ of $i_*$ on these categories (the exceptional inverse image of
[def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] at $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, and of
[sk-thm-existence] in general) has unit an isomorphism

$$
Q\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Ri^!i_*Q\qquad(Q\in D^b_c(Z,\Lambda)).
$$

At $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$ the right adjoint exists on the ambient categories and
this is [prop-sf-closed-immersion-unit].

proof.text:
*Full faithfulness.* The argument is the same for every $\Lambda$. Apply
[sk-prop-sf-open-closed-triangle] with $B=\Lambda_X$, whose inverse image on
$Z$ is $\Lambda_Z$ ([det-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]). The functors
$i^*$ and $i_*$ on $\Lambda$-module sheaves are exact, so they pass to the
derived categories without deriving, and $i^*\dashv i_*$ persists there
([prop-weil-open-closed-recollement-adjunctions]). The counit
$i^*i_*N\to N$ is an isomorphism of sheaves, because $i_*$ is fully
faithful on module sheaves ([sk-prop-sf-open-closed-triangle]). Applied
termwise to a complex, it is an isomorphism $i^*i_*\cong\operatorname{id}$ on
$D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$. A right adjoint whose counit is an
isomorphism is fully faithful, so $i_*$ is fully faithful on
$D(-_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$, hence on the full subcategories $D^b_c$.

*The unit.* Let $Ri^!$ be the right adjoint of $i_*$ on $D^b_c$
([sk-thm-existence], (3) and (4), with $Ri_!=i_*$ since $i$ is proper), and fix
$Q$. For every $P$ the composite of $\eta_Q\circ-:\operatorname{Hom}(P,Q)\to
\operatorname{Hom}(P,Ri^!i_*Q)$ with the adjunction bijection onto
$\operatorname{Hom}(i_*P,i_*Q)$ is, by a triangle identity, $g\mapsto i_*g$,
which is bijective by full faithfulness. So $\eta_Q\circ-$ is bijective,
naturally in $P$, and Yoneda makes $\eta_Q$ an isomorphism, exactly as in
[prop-sf-closed-immersion-unit].
